title: 8-Storey Building Structural Design
program: University of Rome Tor Vergata — Special Structures
description: Full structural design of an 8-storey reinforced-concrete residential and commercial building, verified for static and seismic loads under Italian code.
body: A complete structural design for an 8-storey mixed residential and commercial building with a reinforced-concrete framed structure, covering slabs, beams, columns, stairs and foundations.
Static and seismic verifications follow Italian technical standards (NTC), with the full calculation and drafting carried out in AutoCAD, SAP2000 and Excel.

sections.title: Slab
body: The frame in plan, then the slab worked through from layout to reinforcement: the one-way system spanning between beams, its section build-up, and the bar schedule that follows from the static and seismic verifications.

scenes.title: Framed Structure
scenes.caption: The reinforced-concrete frame in plan — column grid, primary and secondary beams, and the cores that carry the seismic action.

scenes.title: Layout and Section
scenes.caption: Slab layout across the floor plate, with the section detail showing the build-up through the depth.

scenes.title: Reinforcement
scenes.caption: Bar layout and schedule, sized from the static and seismic verifications to NTC.

sections.title: Beams
body: Bending moment and shear envelopes along a continuous beam line, with the resulting longitudinal bars and stirrup spacing drawn span by span.

sections.title: Columns
body: Column schedule through the full height of the building, with cross sections and reinforcement detailing at the changes in section.

sections.title: Stair
body: The stair as an inclined slab spanning between landings, with its reinforcement drawn through the knee joints where the geometry changes direction.

sections.title: Foundations
body: Foundation beams tying the column bases together, detailed in section and set out across the footprint below the frame.
